@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+---
+assignees:

+- 01M5F3D4VMZDN4VPA8D2MY7ET8

+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: 'ROUTER-1: SessionConfiguration carries the facts; a vend writes facts.json and a restore reads it'
+---
+## Goal
+The first `facts.json` of each session comes from its `SessionConfiguration`; a restore reads it back; the live session holds its facts and can rewrite them (the directory uses that later for tags, title and archive).
+
+## Spec
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-router.md#router-1-session-facts
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/session.md section 5.1
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsMultitool/session.md section 13.3
+
+## What
+- `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/SessionConfiguration.swift`: add `agentID: String?`, `agentName: String?`, `tags: Set<String>`, `title: String?`, `startedBy: ULID?`, `origin: FoundationModelsExtras.SessionOrigin?` (qualified: `hookOrigin` already uses the Hooks `SessionOrigin`), each with a default in `init` so no caller changes. They are not in `persistable` (the sidecar stays as it is).
+- `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/RoutedLLM.swift` (`makeSession(configuration:)` and the internal `makeSession(grammar:...)`): pass the facts on to `makeRoutedSessionActor`.
+- `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/RoutedSessionActor.swift`: the actor holds its `SessionFacts`; it writes the first `facts.json` where the `SessionSidecarOrigin.new` sidecar is written (`Recording/SessionSidecar.swift`); an internal `updateFacts(_ change: (inout SessionFacts) -> Void) async throws -> SessionFacts` rewrites the file atomically; `RoutedSession` (`Session/RoutedSession.swift`) gets `var facts: SessionFacts { get async }`.
+- `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Recording/SessionTreeRestoration.swift` (`restoreSessionTree`): read `facts.json` of each restored node; a node with no file (a session from before this change) gets empty facts and one log warning, not an error.
+- Fork (`Session/RoutedSessionActorForking.swift`): the child copies the agent id, agent name and tags of its source, has no title, and has origin `.fork`.
+- The kind (root, subagent, fork) is not stored: it comes from `agentSpawn` and the fork link.
+
+## Subtasks
+- [ ] Failing test first: a session vended with agent id, tags, title, `startedBy` and origin writes `facts.json` with those values, and its `session.json` has no new key.
+- [ ] Add the configuration fields and thread them through the vend path to the actor's first write.
+- [ ] Add `facts` on `RoutedSession` and the internal `updateFacts`; a change rewrites `facts.json` and leaves `session.json` unchanged.
+- [ ] Restore reads `facts.json` back; a recording with no `facts.json` restores with empty facts and a logged warning.
+- [ ] A fork writes its own `facts.json` with origin `.fork` and the agent of its source.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A new session's `facts.json` equals the facts of its configuration; `session.json` decodes to the same `SessionSidecar` as before this change.
+- [ ] After `updateFacts`, `facts.json` holds the new value and `session.json` is byte-for-byte unchanged.
+- [ ] `restoreSession(id:)` gives a session whose `facts` equal what was written, including a `folder:` agent id.
+- [ ] A restore of a recording with no `facts.json` succeeds, gives empty facts, and logs one warning (checked with the log assertions helper).
+- [ ] Existing `SessionSidecarTests`, `SessionRestorationTests` and `SessionTreeRestorationTests` still pass.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/SessionFactsRecordingTests.swift` with the scripted models of `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTestSupport` and `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/Helpers/RouterTestFixtures.swift`.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter SessionFactsRecording` passes; the full `swift test` stays green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #session #recording
\ No newline at end of file
